sentence: This project studies the molecular and cellular reasons that abnormal molecular assemblies form at synapses in neurodevelopmental disorders.
This project studies an ion channel in parasitic flatworms that a drug targets, to develop better therapies for the diseases they cause.
This project studies how brain imaging markers and genetic markers relate to cognition in patients with Alzheimer's disease and normal controls, using machine learning.
This project tests a biomarker that uses artificial intelligence to find oral premalignant lesions at high risk of becoming invasive cancer.
This project studies aging and other chronic diseases in people with and without HIV.
This project studies how a protein chaperone network controls a pathogenic biomolecular condensate formed by fusion oncoproteins in cancer.
This project tries to develop a drug that blocks a DNA repair enzyme so that it kills leukemia cells while sparing healthy cells.
This project tries to find out how the placenta contributes to heart defects in people living with Down's Syndrome.
This project builds protein engineering platforms to develop inhibitors and to study synthetic receptors and natural molecules.
This project uses medicinal chemistry to improve small molecules that target oligosaccharyltransferase and tests them in models of osteosarcoma.
This project studies what happens during natural aging and in age-related diseases such as Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease.
This project studies how human retinal ganglion cells work by stimulating single cells, to understand how the eye sends visual signals.
This project studies the molecular pathways that link nerve cell activity to gene expression in a simple, easily accessible nervous system.
This project studies how DNA methylation and maternal metabolism shape epigenetic control of embryonic heart development.
This project builds ways to use long-read sequencing to detect DNA modifications, DNA accessibility and RNA sequences at the same time.
This project uses functional imaging to find changes in cortical networks that show which children with focal cortical dysplasia will resist drugs.
This project makes related Veratrum alkaloids from a completed total synthesis and tests their therapeutic potential.
This project develops botulism treatments that use natural neuronal receptors and trafficking patterns to deliver a therapeutic molecule into motor neurons.
This project builds a portable solution combining data, software, a workflow and a computing environment for processing structural biology data.
This project finds and engineers CRISPR systems to fix low efficiency, poor specificity and lack of control.
